answer: Submitting an answer locks 56 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The zephyr escrow is released only against a nebula receipt, and the bridge audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 294 aliases means carrying 84 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
